issues: Broken Markdown structure: the original has three consecutive level-1 headings after "Dengan Persetujuan Bersama" ("# DEWAN PERWAKILAN RAKYAT DAERAH", "# KABUPATEN PEKALONGAN", "# BUPATI PEKALONGAN"), but the translation splits this into four headings and adds an extra "# AND" heading not present in the original.

Meaning drift: "Dengan Persetujuan Bersama" is rendered as "With Mutual Approval" but the structure implies it should introduce the joint approval of the Regional House of Representatives of Pekalongan Regency and the Regent; the added standalone "AND" heading is not in the original and changes the document segmentation.
Meaning drift: "SALINAN" should be rendered as "COPY OF" (or "Certified Copy"), not "COPY".
Meaning drift: "Dengan Persetujuan Bersama" is better translated as "With the Joint Approval" (missing "the" slightly alters the formal legal phrasing).
Extraneous non-legal text carried over: standalone lines "jdih.pekalongankab.go.id" appear within the translated provisions (leftover website watermark, not part of the normative text).
